title: matricaria multicaulis
intro: Matricaria multicaulis, commonly known as bitter chamomile or wild chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria multicaulis include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant, making it useful for treating conditions like anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Matricaria multicaulis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
